homeTitle: Ego Hygiene | Balance, awareness, empathy, and growth

about.description: The ideas behind Ego Hygiene: balance, awareness, empathy, and growth.
about.intro: Ego Hygiene is a framework for building steadier relationships with identity, emotion, creativity, and technology.
about.balance: Balance sits at the center: not as perfection, but as a practice of noticing, adjusting, and reconnecting.
about.identity: The galaxy yin-yang identity represents movement, contrast, and an ongoing effort to bring awareness and empathy into the tools we make.
about.progress: The platform is evolving in public, starting with a small, honest foundation.

ecosystem.description: Explore the tools and projects taking shape in the Ego Hygiene ecosystem.
ecosystem.intro: A typed product registry keeps the current platform honest while preparing the root site to become a gateway later.

privacy.description: A provisional explanation of the current website’s privacy practices.
privacy.intro: This provisional draft is here to explain the current state plainly.
privacy.current: The first public website is static and does not require sign-in or collect personal data through a backend.
privacy.future: Future changes will update this page before stronger guarantees are claimed.
privacy.preferences: The site can save theme and language preferences in your browser. Blocking browser storage does not prevent browsing.
